latestRelease.updateLog:
v1.0.2

• Complete UI overhaul: tile-based (Minecraft-style) home screen with a hero launch card and 3x2 tile grid.
• New External Sources page: browse launch sources and renderers from a hosted JSON manifest, with refresh + custom URL override.
• Update dialog redesign: entire dialog is now scrollable so long changelogs can be read and the Update button stays in view.
• Fixed world download: worlds now save to /saves/ instead of /resourcepacks/.
